breakfast.name: Gimbap (Korean Seaweed Rice Rolls)
breakfast.description: Popular Korean grab-and-go meal of seasoned rice rolled with vegetables and protein, sliced into rounds. Can be eaten warm or at room temperature with many regional variations
ingredients: 2 eggs, cooked into omelette and sliced
instructions: Cook short-grain rice and season while warm with sesame oil and salt
Blanch spinach, squeeze dry, then season with sesame oil and salt
Cook beef with soy sauce and sesame oil
Cook seasoned burdock root separately
Make thin omelette, cool, and slice into strips
Place bamboo sushi mat on work surface and lay nori sheet shiny side down
Spread approximately 1 cup warm seasoned rice evenly over nori (leave 3/4 inch at top)
Arrange fillings in horizontal line across center, starting with smaller ingredients
Roll tightly using mat, applying even pressure
Brush seam with water to seal
Remove mat and brush outside with sesame oil
Cut into 6-8 pieces using sharp, wet knife
Serve warm or at room temperature
breakfast.notes: Proper order of filling ingredients is crucial to keep stacked ingredients in place as you roll. Sesame oil is essential for authentic flavor
breakfast.fun_fact: Gimbap is the most popular grab-and-go meal in Korea and can be found everywhere with many regional variations. It's often made with different fillings depending on region and preference

lunch.name: Bibimbap (Korean Mixed Rice Bowl)
lunch.description: Mixed rice bowl with vegetables, beef and egg. Name means mixed rice, represents harmony of different ingredients
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (mushroom, spinach, zucchini, bean sprouts, carrot)
instructions: Season vegetables: sauté each separately with sesame oil, garlic, salt, keep warm
Season beef with soy sauce, garlic, sesame oil, cook until done
Divide rice among bowls
Arrange vegetables and beef on top
Make indentation in center, crack raw egg into it
Top with gochujang and sesame seeds
Serve with bowl of hot broth on side
Mix everything together before eating
lunch.notes: Each vegetable should be seasoned separately for best flavor. Raw egg cooks from heat of rice
lunch.fun_fact: Bibimbap name means mixed rice, represents harmony of different ingredients in one bowl. Popular lunch throughout Korea

dinner.name: Korean Bulgogi (Korean BBQ Beef)
dinner.description: Thinly sliced beef marinated in sweet soy - Korean dinner favorite
ingredients: 600g beef sirloin, tenderloin or rib eye, very thinly sliced
instructions: Freeze beef 20-30 minutes to make slicing easier; slice very thinly
Combine soy sauce, mirin, sesame oil, minced garlic, minced ginger, sugar, black pepper
Add grated pear; stir to combine
Add beef slices and onion to marinade; toss well
Marinate at least 30 minutes (overnight for deeper flavor)
Heat large skillet or grill pan over medium-high to high heat
Cook marinated beef 3-5 minutes per side until caramelized
Do not overcrowd pan; work in batches
Transfer to serving plate; garnish with sesame seeds and scallions
Serve immediately with steamed rice, kimchi, and ssamjang
dinner.notes: Pear enzymes tenderize beef while adding subtle sweetness
dinner.fun_fact: Pear is essential for tenderizing and creating flavor

dinner.name: Galbitang (Short Rib Soup)
dinner.description: Korean beef short rib soup with vegetables - warming and nourishing
instructions: Blanch beef short ribs in boiling water 5 minutes, drain and rinse
Bring fresh water to boil, add blanched ribs
Add ginger slices, bring back to boil
Reduce heat and simmer 40 minutes until ribs are tender
Add daikon radish, carrots, potatoes
Continue simmering 20 minutes until vegetables are tender
Add garlic, soy sauce, sugar
Simmer 10 more minutes
Add perilla leaves (or spinach), scallions
Drizzle with sesame oil
Season with salt and pepper
Serve hot in bowls
Garnish with roasted sesame seeds
dinner.notes: Blanching ribs removes impurities for clear broth. This is a nourishing family soup
dinner.fun_fact: Galbitang is often served on special occasions in Korea
